BiblicalUsage: Helek is a son of Gilead, named in the census of Manasseh as the father of the Helekites, and again in the lot of the rest of Manasseh's children. The clan takes its name from him, and the name is the record of the family.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the Helekites are counted because Helek is counted, and God keeps the families of Manasseh in full.
